newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 10.77 points to 6,813.09 after racking up two straight days of gains following profit-taking in high-flying blue-chips. For the week, the index was up 116.61 points.

* The Jakarta composite index rose 0.56 percent, or 3.82 points, to close at 691.12 points after easing briefly to a low of 687.87 late in the afternoon. It was up 12.2 points, or 1.8 percent, on the week.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,376.00/7.00 in early trading against the opening of 2,375.80/76.50.
* Feedmill and poultry processing firm PT Anwar Sierad on its plan to split its stock and change its board of directors which subject to shareholder's approval in February.
* Transportation firm PT Zebra Nusantara on news that it plans to have a rights issue to acquire Steady Safe . The rights issue is estimated to raise about 100 billion rupiah.
* Conglomerate Bimantara Citra on a report that it had increased its holding in PT Nestle Indonesia from 19.95 percent to 20 percent.
* Tin miner PT Tambang Timah on a report that the firm had signed an Memorandum Of Understanding with Mohammad Hasan to take part in the Busang gold project.
* PT Bakrie Brothers on plans to sell 49 percent share of PT Indocopper Investama Corp, which has a stake in PT Freeport Indonesia, subject to shareholders' approval in March.
* PT Bakrie Brothers on its plan to sell 20 percent of its stake in coal mining firm PT Arutmin.
* PT Multipolar Corp after shareholder approval on Thursday of its plan to take a 50.1 percent controlling interest in retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima.
* PT Barito Pacific on rumours that new investors may enter Indonesia's largest plywood firm.
* PT Lippo Life on news it had revised up its 1996 net profit target to 130.8 billion rupiah from 100.3 billion rupiah.
* PT Great River Industries on news it had set a sales target of 360 billion rupiah in 1997.
